text: Tuition CNY 30/teaching hour/person Study more than 100 teaching hours, the tuition fee would be CNY 25/teaching hour/person. Notes: Students can choose Comprehensive Chinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese Speaking, Chinese Writing and Reading, etc and suitable textbooks with their options; Class schedule can be arranged with students requirements; Every student should take at least 10 teaching hours per week; The tuition fee would be charged by CNY
